title: iota and String
hints: The constants are numbered by iota: Sunday is 0, Monday 1, and so on up to Saturday, 6. String can use a switch, or index into an array of names after checking the range.
Values outside 0–6 are possible (Weekday(9)), so String must not index out of range. Next wraps around with the remainder operator.
String: if d < Sunday || d > Saturday { return fmt.Sprintf("Weekday(%d)", int(d)) }; return names[d]. Next: return (d + 1) % 7. IsWeekend: return d == Saturday || d == Sunday.
